newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 12.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
China commemorates the 130th anniversary of the birth of Dr. Sun Yat-sen, urging the nation to carry forward his revolutionary and patriotic spirit.
The Ministry of Public Health orders health food makers to apply for licences and to submit their products for testing by the end of the year.
China's January-October copper output was 745,900 tonnes, a rise of 6.66 percent from the same period last year.
Aluminium output during the period was 1.4 million tonnes, up 3.05 percent from the year-ago period.
Output of synthetic rubber from January to October was 457,000 tonnes, up 11.6 percent compared to the same period a year ago.
Production of natural rubber during the period was 370,000 tonnes and is forecast to hit 430,000 by the end of the year.
Dai Xianglong, head of the People's Bank of China, the central bank, says China is within reach of achieving economic growth of 9.8 percent this year.
